lines.zh: 八条腿在冰水里划得很快。
lines.en: Eight legs paddle fast through the icy water.
I walk sideways; it is faster than forward.

lines.zh: 这些石头上全是我的抓痕。
lines.en: These rocks are covered in my claw marks.
A wave hits; I cling tight to the reef.

lines.zh: 我的关节在冷里咔咔响。
lines.en: My joints click in the cold.
I squeeze through a gap in the reef.
One leg slips on the kelp.
I follow the waterline, looking for food.
The cold sea slows me, but I do not stop.

lines.zh: 我背上的壳碰着石壁响。
lines.en: My shell scrapes along the rock wall.
I step across two rocks at once.
Something is moving in the deeper water.
When the wave pulls back, I advance a stretch.
The paths I take are all narrow.

lines.zh: 我横着爬过一块结霜的礁石。
lines.en: I sidle across a frosted rock.

lines.zh: 我用一只螯撑地，挪上台阶。
lines.en: I brace on one claw and haul up the ledge.

lines.zh: 我举着一只螯，像举着刀。
lines.en: I hold one claw up like a blade.
Cold water flows through the seams of my shell.
I wait for a fish to swim closer.

lines.zh: 泡泡在我嘴边聚成一颗。
lines.en: A bubble gathers at my mouth and swells.

lines.zh: 我的眼睛长在两根小柱上。
lines.en: My eyes sit on two little stalks.
Under the rock it is warmer than above.
I slowly clean one claw.
I count waves in the sound of the tide.

lines.zh: 有只小蟹躲进我的影子。
lines.en: A small crab hides in my shadow.
A few strands of seaweed hang on my shell.

lines.zh: 冰水让我想动又不想动。
lines.en: The icy water makes me restless and still.
I test the strength of my claw.
This reef is mine to guard.
The bubble bursts; I blow another.

lines.zh: 你的气味在冷空气里很重。
lines.en: Your scent is heavy in the cold air.
I raise a claw; do not move yet.
You are standing on my reef.
I size you up with both eye stalks.

lines.zh: 你在水里会很慢，我知道。
lines.en: You would be slow in the water; I know it.

lines.zh: 那只手上的东西是什么？
lines.en: What is that thing in your hand?

lines.zh: 我只从石缝里露出半只眼。
lines.en: I show only half an eye from the crevice.
Step back, and I lower my claw.
My shell is harder than your boots.
You stand too straight, too visible.
A white crack opens on my shell.
One of my legs gives way.
I leap back into the crevice.
The current carries my blood away.
I cannot raise my claw.
That blow struck my joint.

lines.zh: 我嘶了一声，泡沫从嘴里冒出。
lines.en: I hiss, foam bubbling from my mouth.

lines.zh: 我贴着石头，慢慢缓过来。
lines.en: I press to the rock and slowly recover.
My shell is cracked; cold gets inside.
I remember where you were standing.
Fish? Throw it over; do not hand it to me.
I can smell carrion already.
That thing is moving; I want it.
My claws are already open.
Lower it a bit; I can reach.
I will not eat anything long dead.
This smell makes me forget the reef.
I sidestep two steps closer.

lines.zh: 别用手喂，我会连手一起夹。
lines.en: Do not feed me by hand; I may clamp the hand too.
Got it; I retreat to the crevice to eat.

lines.zh: 我的壳撞你，像撞一口钟。
lines.en: My shell hits you like a struck bell.
Your leg touched my claw.

lines.zh: 八条腿一乱，我差点翻过去。
lines.en: My eight legs tangled, and I nearly flipped.
I push back hard and do not yield.

lines.zh: 冷水溅起来，我们各退一步。
lines.en: Cold water splashes; we each back off.
My spines scraped your sleeve.
Wedged in the crevice, I yield first.
Do not step on my legs.
We bump with a dull thud.

lines.zh: 我横着滑开，站稳再回头。
lines.en: I slide sideways, steady myself, then look back.
I tap three times beneath the reef.
She raises a claw in reply, same rhythm.

lines.zh: 冷海里我们靠气味相认。
lines.en: In the cold sea we know each other by scent.
I guard the crevice entrance for her.

lines.zh: 我们的螯轻轻碰了一下。
lines.en: Our claws touch, very lightly.
She is larger than I am; I do not mind.
We pair when the tide is coldest.

lines.zh: 我清理了一块石头给她。
lines.en: I cleared a stone for her.
She blows bubbles, and I blow them too.

lines.zh: 以后这块礁石有两道抓痕。
lines.en: Soon this reef will bear two sets of claw marks.
Not my back; there are spines there.
All eight of my legs are struggling.

lines.zh: 你抓的是螯，小心它合上。
lines.en: You grabbed a claw; mind it closing.
Out of water my gills will dry.

lines.zh: 我比看上去沉，壳里全是水。
lines.en: I am heavier than I look; my shell is full of water.
Put me back in the rock crevice.
My legs kick wildly in your grip.
Held like that, I will lose a leg.
I clamp down on your glove.
Do not lift me high; I fear the fall.
There is blood in the water.
That shape is at the edge of the reef.
I lower myself, every leg tensed.
It is smaller than I am; I will try.
My claws are raised as high as they go.

lines.zh: 有东西踏进我的范围了。
lines.en: Something has stepped into my range.
I fix my eyes on its neck.
The cold sea makes me hungry fast.
First I cut off its retreat.
A bubble is already forming in my mouth.
I circle it sideways, looking for a gap.
When it moves, my claws follow.
I drive it into the corner of the reef.

lines.zh: 我的腿在石上敲出声音。
lines.en: My legs tap a rhythm on the stone.
It retreats; I take one step.
A freezing bubble turns between my jaws.
I wait for it to strike first.
The spray is blocking its sight.
My shell faces it squarely.
In three seconds I will lunge.
My claw snaps shut with a sharp crack.
I clamp onto its ankle.
One claw strikes, one claw guards.
I ram it from the side.
This clamp can crush a shell.
My spines rake across its hide.

lines.zh: 它挡住了，我换另一只螯。
lines.en: It blocked, so I switch claws.
All eight legs bear down at once.
After the blow I back into the water.
One more hit and it will stagger.

lines.zh: 我从深水的暗处爬上来。
lines.en: I climb up from the dark of deep water.

lines.zh: 壳还软，我先躲在礁石下。
lines.en: My shell is soft; I hide under the reef.
Cold water fills my gills.
New claw marks appear on the reef.

lines.zh: 我第一次举起螯试了试。
lines.en: I raise my claws for the first time and test them.

lines.zh: 这片浅滩有鱼，也有猎人。
lines.en: These shallows hold fish, and hunters.
I walk sideways into the surf.
It is cold, and I like it that way.

lines.zh: 我找了一块背风的石头。
lines.en: I find a stone sheltered from the wind.

lines.zh: 从今天起，这段礁石归我。
lines.en: From today, this stretch of reef is mine.

lines.zh: 火在水面上也能烧到我。
lines.en: Even over water, fire can reach me.

lines.zh: 我从礁石上摔下，壳先着地。
lines.en: I fell from the reef, shell first.

lines.zh: 我该在水里，可这次沉了。
lines.en: I belong in water, yet now I sink.

lines.zh: 冲击把礁石和我一起掀开。
lines.en: The blast tears the reef and me apart.

lines.zh: 那支箭穿过了壳的接缝。
lines.en: The arrow slipped through my shell's seam.
My legs will not obey me.

lines.zh: 鱼都躲起来了，螯也发软。
lines.en: The fish have hidden; even my claws feel weak.

lines.zh: 闪电落进浅水，我全身发麻。
lines.en: Lightning hits the shallows; my whole body numbs.
No bottom below me, and no sound at all.
